name: open-source-release R-6: AppImage GPL guard suite FAILS against a mutant build-appimage.sh whose GPL-library guard never fires
summary: Re-measured at 07:25Z after WI-10004186 edited build-appimage.sh (sha256 30ed36c53c987778baecef345f4f82f561e34a3959d3f61508298566871b3e2c) for the pipefail early-consumer fix. The first measurement was at 03:51Z against the earlier bytes. This is a copy-out counterexample, so the shared tree was never mutated. The test resolves ../bin/build-appimage.sh relative to its own location, so both files were copied into a temp tree and only that copy was mutated. The mutation replaces the GPL-library guard `if [ -n "$_gpl_hits" ]` with `if false`, which lets a GPL-only library reach the AppDir without failing the build. Against the mutant the suite goes red: 7 tests, 5 pass, 2 fail, exit 1. The two failures are 'the guard fails the build when a GPL codec library reaches the AppDir' and 'D-013: the guard fails on each newly covered GPL library'. A matched baseline in the same run, using the unmutated copy, passed 7/7. The mutant still parses (bash -n ok).

assertions.evidence: node --test on the mutant reported tests 7, pass 5, fail 2 and exited 1. The two failures were 'the guard fails the build when a GPL codec library reaches the AppDir' and 'D-013: the guard fails on each newly covered GPL library'.
The unmutated copy in the same temp layout passed 7, failed 0, exit 0.
cmp found the mutant differs from the original (no NOOP-MUTATION), and bash -n parsed the mutant.
